summary: Iteration 55 - Testing mobile optimisation features: bottom navigation bar, mobile pill tabs, Report FAB button, and Master Admin/Portal Switcher in mobile hamburger menu. All features working correctly.

mobile_bottom_nav_pulse.details: Mobile bottom nav visible on Pulse dashboard at 390px viewport with Home, Equipment, Faults, Docs, Reports tabs + Report FAB

mobile_bottom_nav_gymaxis.details: Mobile bottom nav visible on GymAxis dashboard at 390px viewport with Home, Equipment, Faults, Reports, AI tabs + Report FAB

mobile_bottom_nav_hidden_desktop.details: Mobile bottom nav correctly hidden on desktop (1920px viewport) for both Pulse and GymAxis

desktop_tabs_visible.details: Desktop tab bar visible on desktop, hidden on mobile for both Pulse and GymAxis

mobile_tab_switching.details: Clicking bottom nav tabs (Home, Equipment, Faults, etc.) correctly switches dashboard content

mobile_pill_tabs.details: Mobile pill tabs visible for extra sections (Check Sheets, AI Diagnosis, Gym Layout) and switch content correctly

mobile_report_fab.details: Report FAB button opens fault reporting dialog correctly

mobile_master_admin_button.details: Master Admin button visible in mobile hamburger menu for admin users (orange text)

mobile_portal_switch_button.details: Portal Switch button visible in mobile hamburger menu for admin users - shows 'Switch to Pulse Portal' on GymAxis and 'Switch to GymAxis AI' on Pulse

pulse_lite_landing.details: Pulse Lite landing page (/pulse?tier=lite) displays correctly with 'Your Equipment. Managed Simply.' hero

pulse_pro_landing.details: Pulse Pro landing page (/pulse?tier=pro) displays correctly with 'Total Control. AI-Powered Maintenance.' hero

critical_code_review_comments: MobileBottomNav.js correctly uses md:hidden to hide on desktop and show on mobile
Desktop TabsList uses hidden md:flex to show on desktop and hide on mobile
Mobile pill tabs correctly filter out tabs that are in the bottom nav
Report FAB button correctly triggers setShowFaultDialog(true) and setActiveTab('faults')
Navbar.js correctly shows Master Admin and Portal Switch buttons for admin users in mobile menu
context_for_next_testing_agent: All mobile optimisation features are working correctly. Mobile bottom nav shows on mobile (390px) and hides on desktop (1920px). Desktop tabs show on desktop and hide on mobile. Mobile pill tabs provide access to extra sections not in bottom nav. Report FAB opens fault dialog. Admin users see Master Admin and Portal Switch buttons in mobile hamburger menu.

mobile_bottom_nav.report_fab: Floating + button that opens fault dialog
mobile_bottom_nav.visibility: md:hidden (visible on mobile, hidden on desktop)

desktop_tabs.visibility: hidden md:flex (hidden on mobile, visible on desktop)
